section.description: The report section the line belongs to (`report.SECTIONS`).

source.description: Where the file came from: one of `Source`'s values, or another word the engine reports; null when there is none.

status.description: What the sound check made of the file, or null.

ids.description: Every song the screen of the listing shows, each once, in the order shown.

message.description: A verb's "all" that selects none: the words the window says then.

SettingKey.description: A choice in Settings that a read needs (its key in settings.json): `setting_off` names it in `setting`.

Source.description: Where a file came from; `manual` is a file the user bought or owns.

SourceHow.description: How a download's source was found (the engine's `source_how`): the exact Qobuz track, its ISRC, a name search, the playlist's own upload, the fallback search, or picked by the user.

Status.description: What the sound check made of a file.

Todo.description: The To-do page (`todo`): the groups always in the order of `TodoFilter` (the import adds `same_song` and `duplicate` after the first; issue 43 `missing_file` second). `chips` counts exclude hidden items.

check_tracks.description: The tracks with an open check in rekordbox whatever the filter (a batch counts its `size`): the page header's number.

chips.description: How many items each filter holds, a key for every `TodoFilter` (hidden ones left out; `chips.all` counts each song once; `rekordbox_check` counts items, a batch is one).

empty.description: Why the page has nothing to show, or null.

empty_text.description: `empty`'s words for the command line ("Everything is lossless."), null for no state or one the engine has no words for.

groups.description: The groups with items, in order.

hidden_count.description: How many hidden items there are, for "Show hidden (N)".

sub.description: The page header's second line as parts in order of importance ("3 tracks are not lossless yet", "2 songs are missing their file"; ["Nothing to do"] when none).

TodoGroup.description: One group of the To-do page.

stopped.description: The newest stopped batch with items left (`upgrade_ready`, `cdj`).

TodoGroupKey.description: A To-do group: a `TodoFilter` without `all`. The groups always come in this order.

TodoGroupStopped.description: The newest stopped batch with items left.

TodoItem.description: A To-do item as a group lists it: any of the optional keys of the groups' items.

added.description: The playlist day (an ISO time); for an own file the day Discjockey first saw it.

aiff.description: `cdj` items: why Convert can't run now (an `EligibleReason` key), null when it can.

batch.description: A batch's open checks (two or more) are one item.

can_undo.description: `rekordbox_check` items: the check belongs to a swap or an added file `undo_upgrade` can still put back.

cdj.description: `cdj` items: what the CDJs refuse in the file.

cover_url.description: The media URL of the embedded cover, else the Spotify image URL, else null (show a placeholder).

cutoff_hz.description: The measured cutoff in Hz, if measured; `quality_label` is its words.

detail.description: The row's short line (what to do, or why it is here).

file_state.description: Whether the item's file is there now (`FileState`), or `no_file`: the song has none (Not found).

folder.description: The playlist folder the file is in; empty for the user's own songs from the import, which belong to no playlist folder.

free.description: The artist gives it away: a not found, weak, good lossy or fake track with a free download (the row's FREE tag). Not sent by the engine on a `rekordbox_check` item (finding).

group.description: The group the item is in.

hidden.description: Whether the user hid the song.

in_playlists.description: Whether a playlist still holds the song.

missing.description: `missing_file` items (issue 43): the song's waiting file, with its action and the engine's words.

own.description: A file of the user's own that the import found (no playlist holds it). Not sent by the engine on a duplicate group's item (finding); a `TrackRow` has it always.

pair.description: Only the import's two groups (`same_song`, `duplicate`) have one.

path.description: The file's path (absolute for the user's own songs), or null when there is none.

quality.description: The colour class: lossless green, good_lossy yellow, weak red, fake purple, missing red.

quality_label.description: The words next to the colour: LOSSLESS, 20.0 kHz, LOSSY, FAKE · 16.0 kHz, NOT FOUND.

same_track.description: `upgrade_ready` items: why Same track can't run now (an `EligibleReason` key), null when it can.

source.description: Where the file came from, or null.

source_name.description: The source in short words: Qobuz, YT Music, SoundCloud, YouTube, bought; `own file` for a file the import found.

status.description: What the sound check made of the file.

upgrade_ready.description: Whether a better version is waiting.

TrackAiff.description: What Convert and "Give it its clean name" can do for a file (issue 33 stage D); null on the song: no file, a download or a parked upgrade (the upgrade decision stands). `why_not` set means the action is blocked: for `rekordbox_unreadable`, `cloud` and `rename_blocked` the `action` and its `kind` / `to` / `new_name` / `bytes` are still the step's own (judged as if rekordbox were not in the way; no free name is a rename with `new_name` null), so the card shows Becomes, Name and Space and says why it waits. For any other reason (an `EligibleReason` key such as `named_already`, `away`) `action` is null, `kind` / `to` / `new_name` null, `bytes` 0. `from`, `lossy` and `cdj` always say what the file is.

action.description: What can run, or null when nothing can.

cdj.description: What the CDJs refuse in the file, or null.

kind.description: The kind of item (an `AiffKind`: flac, wav, alac, aiff_hires, tags, name, ...); null when `action` is.

new_name.description: The file's name when done (equal to `name_now` for a Convert whose AIFF ends where the old file was).

to.description: What a Convert makes ("AIFF · 16-bit · 44.1 kHz"); null for a rename.

why_not.description: An `EligibleReason` key when the action is blocked, else null.

UndoPreviewItem.description: One song of an undo preview.

file.description: The song's file, an absolute path.

step.description: The kind of file step an undo would put back (swap, add_new, convert, rename).

UndoPreviewRekordbox.description: rekordbox's state for an undo preview.

needs_rekordbox_closed.description: A step that wrote rekordbox can only be undone with rekordbox quit.

batch.description: The batch undone, null for single songs.

recovered.description: What a recovery of an earlier crash put right, `[what, ok]` per line.

words.description: What the undo says when it worked ("Conversion undone. Your old file is back."); only on success.

UndoUpgradePreviewAnswer.description: What `undo_upgrade` of these songs would do, before it runs. Whether the files changed since is only known when the undo runs.

Upgrade.description: The better version parked for a song (`track().upgrade`); null on the song when none waits. Swap only when `swap_safe` and `swap_possible`; `cue_text` is the line to show.

alignment.description: How it lines up with the current file.

audio_url.description: The media URL of the parked file, or null.

auto_refused.description: The refusal the sync's Auto-upgrade phase recorded, or null.

auto_waits.description: The sync met rekordbox open for this upgrade: true only while the switch is on and Same track could run.

cue_text.description: The line about the cues: the measurement combined with `swap_possible`.

file.description: The parked file's path, under Upgrades ready/.

format_line.description: The parked version's quality in the words of the current file's `source_format_line` ("FLAC · lossless", "AAC · 256 kbps").

found.description: The day it was found, an ISO date.

quality_line.description: The new version's quality, as the current file's `format_line` says it ("FLAC · lossless").

rekordbox.description: rekordbox's cached state on this Mac.

swap_how.description: `in_place`: an AIFF takes the audio; `new_aiff`: a new AIFF with a clean name, rekordbox's track pointed at it.

swap_possible.description: Same track can run now (any format); `why_not` says why not otherwise.

swap_safe.description: The two files measured as the same edit (exact or shifted).

what.description: What it is ("lossless version", or e.g. "256 kbps version").

why_not.description: The eligibility reason key that blocks Same track, null when it can run.

space.description: What the new files need per drive (not for Discard).

drive.description: The folder that decides the drive.
